answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a violet bond tied to one verified identity. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake account separately, so creating a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents recover theirs after good behavior. Even if shale fragments seem cheap alone, the ocean of required deposits makes large-scale fakery uneconomic, because the stake is slashed when an identity cheats.
